vessels.name: Manta
vessels.description: Soar at high speed through open spaces to create the biggest blocks in the Hypersea, or skim your opponents trail to steal theirs.

Charge.description: Skimming a rival plants a bomb that costs one bomb of energy. Every bomb shares ONE fuse, reset by each plant, so they all go off together. Charge sets how long the fuse runs when a plant resets it (MantaStingConfig.asset fuseSeconds x fuseScale, 20 s at rest to 30 s at level 10).

upgrade.label: Contagion
upgrade.description: Anything caught in a bomb's detonation is itself bombed, free - one good route cascades through a whole pack. Snapshotted per bomb at plant time.

words.does: Graze a rival vessel or creature to plant a bomb without them knowing; each costs the energy your skimming gathers. Every bomb shares one fuse and a new plant resets it, so they all go off together, and none can be scraped off.
words.trigger: Passive - skim to arm, graze to plant
words.scales: More Charge makes the shared fuse run longer when a plant resets it: 20 s at rest, 30 s at Charge 10.

Mass.description: An elemental crystal the Manta collects leaves a decoy where it was, with its own element's effect frozen as the tell. A rival who takes it gets a cluster of danger prisms across their course. Mass lengthens how long a decoy stands (MantaStingConfig.asset decoyLifetimeAtFullMass, 2x at level 10).

upgrade.label: Omni Decoy
upgrade.description: The omni crystal leaves a decoy too, an omni crystal with one of its four effects frozen. One elemental and one omni decoy at a time; a new one pops the old.

words.does: Every elemental crystal you collect leaves a decoy where it was, one of its effects frozen as the tell. A rival who takes it gets a cluster of danger prisms laid across their course.
words.scales: More Mass makes a decoy stand longer.

Space.description: Skimming gathers the energy that plants bombs, and turns rival prisms explosive - destroyed, they take their prismscape neighbours with them. Hitting a prism loses all the energy. Space widens the skimmer (Manta.prefab Skimmer scale, 20 to 40).

upgrade.label: Shield Breaker
upgrade.description: Skimming a shielded rival prism pops its shield and makes it explosive.

words.does: Skimming prisms gathers the energy that plants bombs, and turns rival prisms explosive: destroyed, they take their neighbours with them. Touching a prism with your hull sets off every bomb and loses all the energy.
words.scales: More Space widens your skimmer.

Time.description: Hard flat turns on the turn pair. Time makes the Manta faster: cruise speed (VesselTransformer.ThrottleScalerMultiplier, x1.5 at level 10) and the soaring speed (BoostSpeedMultiplier, x1.3 at level 10). Speed shapes the trail, never an element: tall at a crawl, long and thin at Soar, and a Yawstery bends both rails.

upgrade.label: Soar
upgrade.description: Boosting unlocks. The analog turn-boost and the boost button both stay dark until Time 5 (MantaSoarBoostAction.asset, MantaAnalogTurnBoostExecutor.soarUnlockedBy).

words.does: Hard, flat turns on the turn pair, one side per direction. Your trail is a plain trail; Time makes the Manta faster, cruising and soaring.
words.scales: More Time raises your cruise speed and your soaring speed.

rows.pc: W A S D + P ; L '

notes: Phone: abilities on thumb lifts (left thumb = RT, right thumb = LT, both = idle).
Tilt the phone to steer with no thumb down.
Both thumbs off flies at full throttle.
Touch overrides on the prefab: Idle = Soar Boost.
Only a controller has analog triggers: a key, a mouse button or a phone button is a full pull.

words.does: Every bomb you have planted on rivals and creatures goes off at once, and a blast blooms round your own ship as well.

cards.name: Bloomrush
cards.description: Mantas only, and nobody has to learn a button. Soar through the reef to arm your bombs, graze wildlife and rival rays to plant them - silently, one bomb per target, first tag takes it - then reach a crystal before the fuses burn down and set the whole board off at once. Biggest bloomed volume in 90 seconds wins it for your domain.

cards.name: Broadside
cards.description: Every hull that can fight, loose in the Boneyard, each with the weapon it actually has - a Sparrow's guns and rockets, an Urchin's spikes, a Swordfish's sword, a Squirrel's joust, a Dolphin's cone, a Scarab's plate, a Manta's bloom. A hit is worth what it cost you to land, not what you flew: a round is 1, a contact strike 8, a debuff 12, a rocket up to 30. First team to the target wins. Pick the hull you fight best.

cards.name: Brood Rush
cards.description: Hold the nucleus. Every brood the cell births in your color scores a point - first team to three wins.

cards.name: Corona
cards.description: Mantas only - shells of prisms round a heart of omni crystals, and the only way in is through the gates. Skim a shell to arm a bomb, graze a rival to plant it, then dive through the gates and touch a crystal to set every bomb you planted off at once. Every rival a bloom catches is a point that silences them. Never touch a shell with your hull - that sets your bombs off early. Higher intensities add shells, narrow the gates, rim them in danger and thin the crystals. First team to the target wins.

cards.name: Maelstrom
cards.description: A multi-game gauntlet - compete across a lineup of games for the crown.

cards.name: Redline
cards.description: Mantas only, flat out. Both triggers buried is Soar - four times cruise and a turning circle you can hold through most of the lap. The corners that will not take it are cut to the metre, and easing both triggers to make one costs you two seconds of winding the Soar back up. Time crystals make it faster still. Laps, until somebody stops lifting.

cards.name: Regatta
cards.description: Every hull, one circuit, three laps. Three rails run the racing line in the three team colours - an Urchin grinds the one in its colour and a Squirrel skims it, while a Manta, a Rhino, a Scarab or a Sparrow flies beside it. Thread the rings in order - every gate anyone on your team threads counts. The race ends when the first pilot finishes; the team with the most gates wins. Pick your hull, and tap an ally's avatar to pick theirs.

cards.name: Scurry
cards.description: Capture all crystals as fast as you can

vessels.name: Dolphin
vessels.description: Thread the narrowest needles at the highest speeds to build max charge, then drift sideways into a crystal to release one of the biggest blasts in the Hypersea.

Charge.description: Hold the right trigger and every prism standing inside the next crystal blast's destruction volume lights up. Charge sets how THICK that blast is - the capsule's diameter across the beam, authored on VesselExplosionByCrystalEffectSO as 0.75x the authored core at the resting level rising to 1.5x at level 10. It is the one element whose slot both AIMS the weapon and SHAPES it, which is why the sight and the thickness share it: the profile you are widening is the profile the sight draws. Note the total extent across the gape is set by banked energy, so Charge does not make the blast bigger - it redistributes that extent, trading a long thin beam for a fat round one. At level 5 the sight also lights up VESSELS caught in the same volume, each in its own domain's colour.

upgrade.label: Pilot Echo
upgrade.description: The sight shows pilots too - any vessel inside the blast lights up in its own domain colour.

words.does: While held, every prism inside the area your next crystal blast would destroy lights up, so you can line up the shot before you fire.
words.scales: More Charge makes your blast thicker across the beam, trading a long thin beam for a fat round one.

Mass.description: PASSIVE - no input. A cooldown runs continuously and each time it completes the Dolphin seeds one crystal at a random point in the cell's CYTOPLASM (the shell between nucleus and membrane), then restarts immediately. Mass shortens that recharge (authored on DeployTeamCrystalActionSO.cooldownMultiplierAtFullMass, x0.5 at level 10 - the one number that drives the recharge). Below level 5 the seed is an ordinary OMNI crystal wearing the lime free-for-all CTA - your own ammunition, standing in open space, for any pilot who reaches it first. At level 5 the seed lands TEAM-locked and only your domain can collect it.

upgrade.label: Claimed Seed
upgrade.description: Seeded crystals land team-locked - only your domain can collect them.

words.does: On a repeating timer the Dolphin drops a crystal somewhere in the open space of the cell - ammo for your next blast, but any pilot who reaches it first can take it.
words.scales: More Mass seeds crystals more often.

tint.why: CrystalTierColor: a seeding wears the lime of a free-for-all crystal, and the pilot's domain once Mass 5 (Claimed Seed) locks it to them.

Space.description: The crystal-impact cone itself - released by flying into a crystal, so it takes no input of its own. Space carries it further down-range (authored on VesselExplosionByCrystalEffectSO._heightMultiplierAtFullSpace, x2 at level 10). The three elements own three orthogonal dimensions of one blast - skim energy sets its GAPE, Charge sets its THICKNESS, Space sets its REACH - so none of them can steal what another one bought. At level 5 the blast stops eating the pilot's own domain.

upgrade.label: Clean Blast
upgrade.description: The cone spares your own domain - no more friendly fire.

words.does: Skimming prisms banks energy; flying into a crystal spends all of it in a fan-shaped blast ahead that destroys the prisms inside. More energy opens it wider. Ramming a prism halves your bank.
words.scales: More Space makes the blast reach further ahead.

Time.description: Time raises the rate the boost meter charges while drifting (authored on ChargeBoostActionSO.chargeRateMultiplierAtFullTime, x1.5 at level 10). Time deliberately does NOT touch this hull's boost SPEED: VesselTransformer.BoostSpeedMultiplier is left disabled on Dolphin.prefab. At level 5 the drift itself becomes the ward - while drifting the Dolphin holds the general elemental-debuff immunity state, so a danger prism's all-element drain does not land.

upgrade.label: Drift Ward
upgrade.description: While drifting you take no elemental debuff - a danger prism's all-element drain does not land. Everything else still does: the full-strength slow (x3 magnitude, x3 duration) and the halving of your banked blast energy. Your banked boost is halved too, but the drift you are already in refills it.

words.does: Hold to drift, sliding at the speed you entered with while your boost meter fills. Let go and the stored boost carries you off in a burst that fades back to cruise.
words.scales: More Time fills the boost meter faster while you drift; it does not raise boost speed.

rows.pc: W A S D + P ; L '

notes: Phone: abilities on thumb lifts (left thumb = RT, right thumb = LT, both = idle).
The phone rolls the hull one to one while the aiming thumb is down.
Touch overrides on the prefab: RightStick = Drift, Charge Boost, Drift Trail, Echo Sight, LeftStick = Drift, Charge Boost, Drift Trail, Echo Sight.
Only a controller has analog triggers: a key, a mouse button or a phone button is a full pull.

words.does: Fires a cone blast ahead that destroys prisms in its path. The energy you banked by skimming sets how wide it opens, and the crystal spends all of it.

cards.name: Rampage
cards.description: A cactus forest rings the membrane and there is exactly one crystal in the arena. Graze the thicket to charge your jaws, take the crystal to unleash the blast, and be the first domain to smash 2000 enemy prisms.

cards.name: Regatta
cards.description: Every hull, one circuit, three laps. Three rails run the racing line in the three team colours - an Urchin grinds the one in its colour and a Squirrel skims it, while a Manta, a Rhino, a Scarab or a Sparrow flies beside it. Thread the rings in order - every gate anyone on your team threads counts. The race ends when the first pilot finishes; the team with the most gates wins. Pick your hull, and tap an ally's avatar to pick theirs.

cards.name: Switchback
cards.description: Dolphins only, through a course of rings nobody placed twice the same way. Every gate is somewhere new and facing somewhere new, and you take them in order - drift the corners, boost the straights, and go back for the one you missed. First team to put a pilot through the last gate takes it.

cards.name: The Bends
cards.description: Dolphins only, in the cactus forest, with no guns anywhere. Graze the thicket to charge your jaws, race a rival to the crystal, and put the cone on a PILOT instead of the trees - a hit strips every element they have and leaves them four seconds of being worse at all of it. Three bends and your domain takes it.

vessels.name: Rhino
vessels.description: A plough. Your hull shoves every prism it hits aside, and a shoved prism that hits another breaks both. Pull a trigger to throw the furrow that way, and run flat out to wind up the ramp.

Charge.description: Ram a rival vessel and its petals come loose: a gore is a scored Strike (8 points, Swordfish sword price) decided on the Rhino's owner, landed only while the Rhino is moving faster than its victim, once per 1.4 s per victim (VesselCombatHitByGore). Charge lowers the least ram speed a gore needs, like the Squirrel joust: 150 u/s at rest (three times the 50 u/s cruise, a short ramp wind-up) down to 50 u/s at level 10 (a cruising Rhino gores), read at the replicated level (RhinoGoreSpeed); a slower contact is neither scored nor robbed. Charge also carries a thrown prism on to strike the next one in its line: 0 u at rest, 40 u at level 10 (RhinoPloughPrismEffect.carryDistance); a thrown prism that strikes another destroys both.

upgrade.label: Gore Steal
upgrade.description: The petals a gore knocks loose land on the Rhino instead of floating free as crystals (RhinoGoreBySkimmerEffectSO.stealUpgradeElement, gated on IsUpgradeActive(Charge); 2026-11-12, replacing Avalanche).

Mass.description: A heavier plough throws further: Mass adds 0 u at rest to 60 u at level 10 to every throw, at any speed, on top of the speed-driven throw (speed x 0.12 s, at most 90 u) (RhinoPloughPrismEffect.furrowDistance, replicated level). Pull a trigger for a shove that way; HOLD it and everything the hull ploughs is thrown to that side, across the centreline (RhinoPloughSteerAction: LT left, RT right, the last one pulled wins). Let go and each prism goes to the side it already sat on.

upgrade.label: Berm
upgrade.description: A ploughed prism LANDS SHIELDED, so the furrow banks into walls of armour; a prism that strikes another still breaks (RhinoPloughPrismEffectSO.bermUpgradeElement, gated on IsUpgradeActive(Mass); Garrett, 2026-11-07).

Space.description: A plough blade across the nose: one hull collider whose width follows Space - 14 u at rest (a little wider than the hull), 40 u at level 10, floored at 10, read at the replicated level (RhinoPloughBlade.width). A wider blade reaches more mass, and the plough throws what it catches clear of the whole blade.

upgrade.label: Unstoppable
upgrade.description: The plough moves SUPER-shielded mass too; without it super-shielded prisms are the immovable tier and only jiggle (RhinoPloughPrismEffectSO.unstoppableUpgradeElement, gated on IsUpgradeActive(Space); Garrett, 2026-11-07). Arena linings and race tracks are super-shielded, so an upgraded Rhino can plough them out of line.

Time.description: Time raises how fast the ramp boost winds the Rhino up to its top speed: 220 u/s per second at rest, 550 at level 10, 110 at the -5 floor (RampBoostActionSO.timeAccelerationMultiplier, x1 -> x2.5, floored x0.5, read live). It does not raise the ceiling - cruise 50 x maxBoostMultiplier 16.8 = 840 u/s - only how long the run-up takes. The Rhino is a bulldozer: its hull carries no prism slow, so ramming mass costs it no speed - the plough shoves what it hits aside (RhinoPloughPrismEffectSO) and the ramp keeps climbing through it.

upgrade.label: Momentum
upgrade.description: Above 70% of top speed (588 u/s) danger prisms cannot drain the Rhino's elements - the elemental-debuff ward scoped to DangerPrism alone, so an opposing pilot's blast still lands (VesselElementalImmunity on the root, condition WhileAboveTopSpeedFraction, upgradeGate Time). The Time card lights while the ward is holding.

words.does: Fly at full throttle in a straight line and the Rhino winds up steadily toward a very high top speed. Turning bleeds it off. Prisms you ram are shoved aside and cost you no speed.
words.trigger: Passive - fly flat out and straight
words.scales: More Time winds you up to top speed faster; the top speed itself stays the same.

rows.pc: W A S D + P ; L '

notes: Phone: abilities on thumb lifts (left thumb = RT, right thumb = LT, both = idle).
Touch overrides on the prefab: RightStick = Plough Steer Right, LeftStick = Plough Steer Left.
Only a controller has analog triggers: a key, a mouse button or a phone button is a full pull.

cards.name: Brood Rush
cards.description: Hold the nucleus. Every brood the cell births in your color scores a point - first team to three wins.

cards.name: Headlong
cards.description: Rhinos only, a stampede. Hold the throttle dead straight and the ramp winds you up to fifteen times cruise - and hedges of mass stand across every straight, so plough straight through them. Swerve and the boost dies. Thorn hedges burn your Time, so slip their window or take the burn. Top intensity starts at Time 5 - carry the corner and Momentum bulldozes the danger. Five laps. Fastest domain home wins.

Thread the rings in order - every gate anyone on your team threads counts. The race ends when the first pilot finishes; the team with the most gates wins. Pick your hull, and tap an ally's avatar to pick theirs.

vessels.name: Urchin
vessels.description: Don't mess with me or I will shoot. I will shoot anyway, but don't mess with me.

Charge.description: One trigger, two shots. TAP it for an aimed shotgun of spikes out of both guns; HOLD it to charge and RELEASE for a burst in every direction, with the spike count taken from how long you held. Every spike embeds in the prism it hits, steals it, and sprays the next generation out of the mass it just took - a cascade that runs for as long as it keeps finding enemy territory. Charge is the weapon's whole ENERGY - how far each spike flies and how deep the chain runs. At level 5 the cascade gains a generation and stops losing reach as it spreads.

upgrade.label: Overcharge
upgrade.description: The cascade runs one generation deeper AND stops decaying. Normally each generation launches shorter than the one before it, so a deep cascade peters out; overcharged, it goes further and the last generation reaches as far as the first.

words.does: Tap for an aimed shotgun of spikes, or hold and release for a burst in every direction. Each spike steals the prism it hits and sprays new spikes from it, chaining through enemy territory.
words.scales: More Charge makes each spike fly further and the chain run deeper.

Mass.description: Fly into a trail to latch onto it and ride, steering by the ribbon rather than the stick. Your own trail GROWS under you as you pass; an enemy's is STOLEN. Riding also recharges ammo, at double rate over shielded prisms. Ride off the END of a ribbon and you launch, keeping the speed the grind was doing. Mass is how much volume each friendly prism gains per pass. Passive - it triggers on contact, not on a button.

upgrade.label: Reinforced Wake
upgrade.description: Prisms you grow while riding arrive shielded. Since a shielded prism pays double ammo to ride over, a fortified lap of your own trail funds the next one.

words.does: Fly into a trail to latch on and ride it. Your own trail grows as you pass, an enemy's is stolen, and riding refills ammo. Ride off the end to launch at grind speed.
words.scales: More Mass makes your own prisms grow more each time you ride over them.

Space.description: Project a straight stretch of single-track trail out in front of you - a rail to launch off where the map has none. It is ordinary mass in your own domain, so you ride it at friendly speed, grow it as you pass, and anyone else can take it from you. Space is how LONG the stretch is. Twenty-second cooldown. At level 5 the projection runs a further hundred units.

upgrade.label: Long Haul
upgrade.description: The projected track is laid a hundred units longer. A longer rail is a longer grind - more ammo recharged, more prisms grown, and more speed carried off the far end.

words.does: Lays a straight stretch of your own trail out ahead of you - a rail to ride where the map has none. Anyone can steal it from you. Twenty-second cooldown.
words.scales: More Space makes the projected track longer.

Time.description: Let go of the trail you are riding and phase out for a moment, so you can clear the mass you were inside instead of being re-latched by it. Time is how long the ghost lasts. At level 5 hostile trail no longer slows you down, so raiding an enemy ribbon is as fast as riding your own.

upgrade.label: Slipstream
upgrade.description: Enemy trail is ridden at your friendly speed. Hostile mass normally crawls, which punishes the raid exactly when you most want to be moving; overcharged, you cross it at full pace while still converting it.

words.does: Let go of the trail you are riding and phase out for a moment, so you can fly clear of the mass you were in without latching back on.
words.scales: More Time makes the phase-out last longer.

Nothing is destroyed here; it only changes hands. First domain to steal the target wins.

cards.name: Skein
cards.description: Urchins only, on a knot of rails that never quite closes. Latch on and the cable does the driving - your colour runs fast, theirs runs at a crawl, and every rail ENDS somewhere, aimed at another. Thread the rings in order; the first team to put a pilot through the last one takes it.

vessels.name: Grizzly
vessels.description: A flying siege tank - big, slow, and explosive. Charge devastating shots, dig in to reload, rush and ride your own shockwaves, and set whole areas on fire. Best at deleting big clusters of enemy prisms in one blast.

Charge.description: Stop to dig in and reload - energy regenerates faster while parked. Charge raises the parked regeneration rate. Level 5 grants battlefield sight while dug in.

upgrade.label: Battle Sight
upgrade.description: While dug in, key targets are highlighted (design in progress - vision/highlight ability per the class doc).

notes: UPGRADE IS PROSE — no live IsUpgradeActive gate

RETIRED CHANNEL PRESENT — this entry still carries a generic map multiplier, or something still calls handler.Multiplier(element). Scaling belongs in an ElementalFloat on whatever owns the number (ELEMENT_SCALING_UNIFICATION.md).

words.does: Toggle to plant the Grizzly in place. You cannot move but can still aim, your trail stops, and energy refills faster. Rushing breaks you out.
words.scales: More Charge refills energy faster while dug in.

Mass.description: Cycle your three weapons - explosives, sniper, and the plasma-claw flamethrower. Mass grows your trail prisms. At level 5 the claw stops destroying what it burns and STEALS it for your team instead.

upgrade.label: Claimed Fire
upgrade.description: The plasma claw stops destroying what it burns - a prism that burns out now joins your domain instead, converting enemy volume into your own. The claw itself is available from the start.

words.does: Cycles your fire between three weapons: explosive shells, a sniper shot, and a plasma claw that sets enemy prisms on fire with a burn that spreads and destroys them.
words.scales: Mass does not change this ability right now.

Space.description: Hold to charge, release to fire - bigger charge, bigger boom. Space grows the explosion radius. At level 5 your blasts spare allies, so you can bombard freely near teammates (you still ride your own shockwaves).

upgrade.label: Safe Detonation
upgrade.description: Friendly fire off - your explosions no longer damage allied vessels or your own domain's prisms. Self-propulsion is unaffected.

notes: RETIRED CHANNEL PRESENT — this entry still carries a generic map multiplier, or something still calls handler.Multiplier(element). Scaling belongs in an ElementalFloat on whatever owns the number (ELEMENT_SCALING_UNIFICATION.md).

words.does: Hold to charge a shell from your energy and release to fire it. Press again to freeze it where it is, then let go to set it off. Bigger charge, bigger blast, and the blast can launch you.
words.scales: More Space makes the cannon's explosions bigger.

Time.description: Spend energy to charge forward with a burst of momentum. Time reduces the energy cost of each rush. At level 5 you can steer mid-rush.

upgrade.label: Vector Control
upgrade.description: Improved directional control - change direction while charging instead of committing to a straight line.

notes: RETIRED CHANNEL PRESENT — this entry still carries a generic map multiplier, or something still calls handler.Multiplier(element). Scaling belongs in an ElementalFloat on whatever owns the number (ELEMENT_SCALING_UNIFICATION.md).

words.does: Spend energy to lunge forward in a burst of speed that fades out over a second. You hold up to three rushes, refilled over time, and using one pulls you out of Dig In.
words.scales: More Time makes each rush cost less energy.

notes: Phone: buttons round the right thumb; lifting a thumb fires nothing.

cards.name: Grizzly Charge
cards.description: Grizzly proving grounds. A cell full of prisms to nuke, an opponent to shove around, and room to ride your own shockwaves. Charge the cannon, dig in, rush, snipe, and burn - a test range today, a tank game tomorrow.

cards.name: Grizzly Time
cards.description: Grizzlies only, against the clock. Your speed is your bombs - squeeze LT or RT to fire, pull again to freeze it, let go to blow it and ride the blast at three times cruise. A launch keeps going the way you were pointed, so every corner asks how much launch it is worth. Two laps. Fastest domain home wins.

vessels.name: Squirrel
vessels.description: Get in your flow and stay there. Hard decisions are for other classes. You’re here to bounce around and ride your speed tubes, leaving a wake of creation and destruction.

Charge.description: BASE (no upgrade needed) - joust a lifeform's crystal while moving faster than it to wither opposing-domain creatures, freeing the heart and auto-collecting it; overtake an opposing PILOT and you steal elemental petals off them. Charge sets the least speed either joust needs - 90 u/s at rest down to 45 u/s at level 10 (SquirrelJoustSpeed.asset minimumSpeed, read from the replicated level; the Charge card's speed gauge marks it) - and every steal takes the flat priced petals. At level 5 the joust also SHEPHERDS allies - an own-domain lifeform is NOURISHED instead (ILifeFormEntity.Nourish - its starvation clock resets and its birth counter advances).

upgrade.label: Shepherd
upgrade.description: Jousting an OWN-domain lifeform's crystal nourishes it instead of doing nothing.

words.does: Overtake a creature's crystal while flying faster than it to wither a rival creature, freeing its heart and collecting it. Overtake a rival pilot to steal petals off them. Either joust needs at least the minimum joust speed.
words.scales: More Charge lowers the speed a joust needs: 90 u/s at rest, 45 u/s at Charge 10. The Charge card's gauge marks it.

Mass.description: Deploy a ring of conserved prism mass ahead of the vessel - the Squirrel's mass-creation ability, which is why it sits on Mass. Mass shortens the deploy cooldown (SquirrelTubeActionSO.cooldownMultiplierAtFullMass, x1 at rest -> x0.5 at level 10, floored), so a heavier pilot lays rings more often. At level 5 each deploy lays a second ring.

upgrade.label: Twin Rings
upgrade.description: The boost ring deploys with a second ring.

words.does: Drops a ring of danger prisms ahead of you to fly through the middle of. Grazing it boosts you, but it slams any vessel that hits it, yours included. Twenty-second cooldown.
words.scales: More Mass shortens the cooldown between rings.

Space.description: Skim a prism to STEAL it into your own domain. Space grows the skimmer sphere (authored on the skimmer's Scale ElementalFloat, 15 -> 30 at level 10, evaluated live), and the sphere IS the steal reach - a bigger skimmer converts more mass per pass. BASE - an opposing SHIELDED prism only loses its shield and keeps its domain. At level 5 the steal goes through the shield - the prism changes hands AND keeps its armour. Super-shielded mass stays invulnerable at every level.

upgrade.label: Iron Grip
upgrade.description: Shielded prisms are stolen outright and keep their shield, instead of merely being stripped of it.

words.does: Skim a prism to steal it into your own domain. A rival's shielded prism only loses its shield, and super-shielded prisms can never be taken.
words.scales: More Space grows your skimmer, so each pass steals from further away.

Time.description: Time raises the boost energy gained per prism-skimmer collision (SkimmerBoostPrismEffectSO.energyMultiplier, x1 -> x2 at level 10 floored at x0.25, read live per hit). Skim energy is the Squirrel's speed, so the element that makes the pilot faster owns it. At level 5 danger prisms grant the 10x energy bonus (below it they pay base energy - the bonus is earned, no longer always on).

upgrade.label: Live Wire
upgrade.description: Danger prisms grant 10x boost energy when skimmed.

words.does: Every prism you skim past gives you boost energy, and that energy is your speed. Keep threading close to mass to stay fast.
words.scales: More Time gives more boost energy for each prism you skim.

rows.pc: W A S D + P ; L '

The phone rolls the hull one to one while the aiming thumb is down.
Touch overrides on the prefab: OnlyRightStick = Tube, OnlyLeftStick = Drift, Drift Trail.

words.does: The crystal opens and becomes a ring of eight shielded prisms just ahead of your nose.

cards.description: Find the fastest path to the crystal by skimming trails for a speed boost.

vessels.name: Serpent
vessels.description: Navigate with just one thumb and place seeds that will steal ALL local blocks into a wall that can be sheilded. Use walls to disrupt enemy volume and navigation.

Charge.description: Hold the left trigger and a magnified view down your own nose opens in a round eyepiece beside the flight view - the ship keeps flying exactly as it did - and the right trigger becomes the Sniper Shot. The zoom is the trigger's own depth: an analog dial out to a 12 degree field of view, the same at every level. Charge sets the sniper's RECOVERY: the wait between shots, 12s at rest down to 5.4s at Charge 10.

upgrade.label: Hunter's Sight
upgrade.description: While the scope is up, every rival in range leaves short-lived afterimages - its hull frozen where it stood, every quarter second, for one second. A sniper round through an afterimage strips the real pilot as if it had hit them. Read from the replicated unlock bit; the afterimages are recorded where the strip is decided.

words.does: Raise a magnified eyepiece beside your flight view - the ship keeps flying as normal - with the zoom following how far you pull. While it is up, your cloak trigger fires the Sniper Shot instead.
words.scales: More Charge shortens the sniper's recovery between shots.

Mass.description: Stopping (the turret stance) or cloaking leaves a seed prism that pulls loose prisms into a self-assembling wall around itself, stealing an opponent's prisms as they land. The pattern is a symmetric herringbone of 2:1 bricks with a square hole at every cell, spaced so that once shielded the octahedral bricks point long vertex at short vertex with a gap between. Mass sets the SIZE and SPACING of the bricks together (SeedWallActionSO.massSizeMultiplierAtFull, x1 at rest to x2 at Mass 10, floored at x0.5), snapshotted when the seed is placed. The wall steals from its EDGE: loose prisms within reach of an open site beside a brick are pulled in, so it grows toward the mass around it and creeps along trails rather than as a circle. Space sets that steal reach (x1 at rest to x2 at Space 10). The stance's seed is shielded and its wall grows only while you stay stopped; fly again and it stands as it is. The cloak's seed is SUPER-SHIELDED and its wall keeps growing until that super-shield breaks; kill a seed and its wall stops. Every crystal you collect fires a beam at each of your growing walls and ripples a shield through it.

upgrade.label: Lockdown
upgrade.description: Every square hole in your walls whose four surrounding bricks have all closed is sealed with a flat DANGER panel, a thin crack short of the shields around it, the moment its fourth brick lands. Crystals still only shield the wall. Read from the replicated unlock bit.

words.does: Stop dead and your last prism becomes a seed that pulls loose prisms into a growing herringbone wall, stealing rival prisms as they land. It grows while you stay stopped, and you shrug off debuffs meanwhile.
words.trigger: Tap to stop, tap again to fly
words.scales: More Mass makes the wall's bricks bigger and more widely spaced.

Space.description: The right trigger. Unscoped, it CLOAKS: you leave a super-shielded seed that grows a Seed Wall and an illusion of your hull where you were, and fly on unseen. Scoped (hold the left trigger), it fires the SNIPER SHOT: one hitscan round, a 1.5 degree cone out to 3000 units, that destroys every hostile prism inside it - SUPER-SHIELDED mass included - and knocks a petal of every element out of each opposing pilot it crosses. The card shows whichever the trigger will do. Space sets how far your Seed Walls reach to steal (x1 at rest to x2 at Space 10).

upgrade.label: Shield Steal
upgrade.description: Your Seed Walls also steal an opponent's SHIELDED prisms from their edge, which they otherwise leave alone.

words.does: Unscoped: vanish, hull and trail, for about 15 s, leaving a decoy and a super-shielded seed that grows a wall. Scoped: one long hitscan round that breaks every hostile prism in its path, shields and all, and strips rival petals.
words.trigger: Tap; fires the shot while scoped
words.scales: More Space lets your Seed Walls reach further to steal prisms.

Time.description: Each press burns one solid fuel pellet - a fixed quarter of the fuel tank - and every pellet burns for its own duration. Press again while one is still burning and a second lights beside it: the burns overlap and each adds the same increment of speed, so four pellets at once is four times the effect of one (3x cruise for one, 9x for four). The tank holds exactly four pellets and never refills on its own: a pellet comes back for every 2 s your Seed Wall spends eating your own trail (fly out at cruise in plane with a wall and the trail is pulled into it). A pellet burns 6 s at rest. Time sets how long a pellet BURNS (ConsumeBoostActionSO.timeDurationMultiplier, x1 at rest to x1.6 at Time 10, floored at x0.25), never how fast.

upgrade.label: Fifth Pellet
upgrade.description: The tank holds FIVE pellets instead of four: each pellet costs a fifth of the tank and still burns and boosts exactly as before, so a full overlap is 11x cruise.

words.does: Each press burns one of four fuel pellets for a burst of speed; press again while one burns and the boosts stack. The tank never refills on a clock - your Seed Wall eating your own trail earns pellets back.
words.scales: More Time makes each pellet burn longer, not faster.

notes: Phone: buttons round the right thumb; lifting a thumb fires nothing.
Only a controller has analog triggers: a key, a mouse button or a phone button is a full pull.

words.does: A blast breaks prisms round you, and beams from the crystal re-shield every seed wall you have standing, rippling out from each seed.

cards.name: Brood Rush
cards.description: Hold the nucleus. Every brood the cell births in your color scores a point - first team to three wins.

cards.name: Hood
cards.description: Serpents only - a sniper duel across a crystal heart. Hoods stand round the heart, every mouth turned to it - sit in a hood's cup and fire out through its gaps. Charge reloads your rifle faster, so the heart is where you load up, in every hood's sights. Hold LT to scope and RT to fire - a round that strips a rival pilot is one snipe. Break a hood's core and the whole hood falls, flushing whoever hid in it. Higher intensities pull the hoods in, deepen their cups and stand shutters across the heart. First team to the target wins.

Thread the rings in order - every gate anyone on your team threads counts. The race ends when the first pilot finishes; the team with the most gates wins. Pick your hull, and tap an ally's avatar to pick theirs.

cards.name: Serpentine
cards.description: Serpents only, and it is a dirty race through a living cell. A great shape closes every ring - coiled at first, then fanged, then an iris - and its weave burns a careless hull. Slip out through a gap, or shoot or ram its gold core and the whole shape comes apart. Cloak just past a ring and a Seed Wall grows in the way of whoever is behind you. Two laps. Fastest domain home wins.

vessels.name: Termite
vessels.description: Send out drones to shrink mass and produce cool stuff

vessels.name: Shrike
vessels.description: A slow sniper that docks to whatever it touches. Build nests of super-shielded blocks, pierce anything with the Void Lance, sling across the cell on a tether, and paint targets for the missiles your nests launch.

Charge.description: Y: Charge mode. RT (held) paints a target - a rival vessel first, then a creature, then a plant, then the centre of the mass nearest your aim - and every nest flora with a ready missile launches it, one each per 0.8 s, homing while you paint. A missile blows on contact in an 18 u blast (a shield takes the hit first); a rival hull inside it is a petal hit (petals only - nothing is moved). The card counts the missiles left across every flora. A collected crystal becomes a nest flora that grows large missiles (one per 6 s, up to 4). Space widens the lock cone 5 -> 14 degrees at level 10 (ShrikeConfigSO.lockCone).

words.does: Paint a target - a rival first, then a creature, a plant or nearby mass - and every nest plant with a ready missile launches it. Missiles home while you paint and burst on contact, a petal hit on any rival caught.
words.trigger: Select mode, then hold fire to paint
words.scales: More Charge does not change the missiles; it widens your Void Lance's beam.

Mass.description: A. Any block you touch docks you (the camera eases back); docked, every cooldown runs x1.6 (x2.5 on super-shielded mass or in a nest). Docked, A detaches you and leaves a nest behind: a cup of super-shielded blocks round where you were, no two touching, the nose's way out open, crowned with a flora carrying ONE missile (8 s cooldown; at most three nests). Mass is volume - one dial: 12 -> 32 blocks per nest at level 10 (ShrikeConfigSO.nestBlocks), and the cruising trail's wavelength 8 -> 4 u (trailWavelength).

words.does: Touch any block and you dock to it; docked, every cooldown runs faster. Detach and you leave a nest behind - a cup of super-shielded blocks crowned with a plant that grows a missile. Up to three nests at once.
words.scales: More Mass builds each nest from more blocks and tightens your trail's wave.

Space.description: X: Space mode. RT (held) fires a hitscan beam 2400 u long that breaks every block it passes, any domain, except super-shielded mass and the nest you are docked in; a rival hull on the line is a scored petal hit. 1.2 s cooldown, faster docked. Charge widens the beam 1.5 -> 5 u at level 10 (ShrikeConfigSO.lanceRadius).

upgrade.label: Void Pierce
upgrade.description: The Void Lance breaks super-shielded mass too.

words.does: Fire a long hitscan beam that breaks every block it passes, any domain, except super-shielded mass and the nest you sit in. A rival hull on the line takes a scored petal hit.
words.scales: More Space does not change the lance; it widens the Targeting Array's lock cone.

Time.description: B: Time mode. RT shoots a tether (1600 u); it anchors on the first block it meets and the hull flies straight there in exactly 1 s, laying thick trail, docking on the first block it touches. A crystal resets it. Time is rate - one dial: the cooldown 6 -> 2.5 s at level 10 (ShrikeConfigSO.slingCooldown).

words.does: Shoot a tether at the first block ahead; the hull flies straight there in one second, laying thick trail, and docks on arrival. No block in range, no sling. A crystal resets it.
words.scales: More Time shortens the sling's cooldown.

notes: Phone: buttons round the right thumb; lifting a thumb fires nothing.
Only a controller has analog triggers: a key, a mouse button or a phone button is a full pull.

words.does: The crystal becomes a nest plant where it was, which grows large missiles you can call down, and your Void Sling is ready again at once.

cards.name: Thornline
cards.description: Shrikes only, and no flying - slinging. Dock on a thorn, aim at the next, and sling through the ring between - one second at any distance, then wait out the reload. Super-shielded thorns reload faster. Aim at a thorn's rim to take the Time crystal on the line, and on the hard levels snipe a far thorn through two rings at once. First team to put a pilot through the last ring takes it.

vessels.name: Sparrow
vessels.description: The classic arcade flyer. Use your Pulsefire Cannons and Skyburst Rockets to destroy enemy blocks, flora, fauna, structures, everything...

Charge.description: Rockets stocked by DESTROYING MASS - every hostile prism you break puts a little back in the rack, so the arena is the ammunition. They carry a proximity fuze and go off near an enemy or a creature rather than only on contact, throwing two blasts - the old one that tears prisms apart and lays new ones, and a wider warhead that debuffs pilots and kills wildlife. Charge widens the prism blast (authored on the skyburst effect assets); at level 5 both explosions spare your own domain.

upgrade.label: Domain-Safe Skybursts
upgrade.description: Skyburst explosions no longer destroy your own domain's prisms - and the warhead no longer kills your own domain's wildlife or debuffs your own pilots, since both halves of the detonation read one friendly-fire decision.

words.does: Fire a rocket that bursts near a rival or creature: one blast tears prisms apart and lays new ones, a wider one debuffs pilots and kills wildlife. Restock rockets by shooting hostile prisms with your guns.
words.scales: More Charge widens the rockets' prism-tearing blast.

Mass.description: Stop and fire prisms instead of bullets - the same shot in every way, except you watch a prism fly and it stays wherever the bullet would have died. Mass is the SUBSTANCE of what you fire: it stretches the fired prisms AND swells every round as it travels (3x over its flight at rest, 6x at level 10), so the hit volume grows with the visual. At level 5 fired prisms arrive shielded.

upgrade.label: Shielded Prisms
upgrade.description: Prisms fired in the turret stance arrive shielded - one-hit ablative octahedron armor, with a wider hit sphere to match. Briefly lived at Space 5 (2026-08 round 4) and was returned here by design sign-off: MASS owns the substance of what you fire, SPACE owns its reach.

words.does: Stop dead and your guns fire prisms instead of bullets - the same shot, but each prism stays wherever the bullet would have died, building mass as you shoot. You can still roll and turn faster while stopped.
words.trigger: Tap to stop, tap again to fly
words.scales: More Mass stretches the prisms you fire and swells every round bigger as it flies.

Space.description: Full-auto cannons. Space extends their range dramatically - short at rest, unchanged at full overcharge. At level 5 shots pierce through prisms - both bullets and turret-stance prism rounds.

upgrade.label: Piercing Bullets
upgrade.description: Shots pierce through prisms instead of being destroyed on first impact - bullets and turret-stance prism rounds alike. SPACE owns REACH; the armour on fired prisms is MASS 5.

words.does: Full-auto cannons that break prisms. A cold gun is pin-accurate; keep firing and it heats, spreading the cone and shortening the range, then cools quickly when you let go.
words.scales: More Space widens your skimmer, the zone that grazes trails; the cannons' range stays fixed.

Time.description: Hold to boost indefinitely - there is no heat and no meter. Boosting at full stick deflection performs one strafing roll per press (base, no unlock). Time raises the boost speed; at level 5 boosting also makes you immune to elemental debuffs.

upgrade.label: Elemental Ward
upgrade.description: While boosting, elemental debuffs cannot land - danger prisms and skimmer overtakes leave your levels untouched. Buffs still apply.

words.does: Boost for as long as you hold - no heat, no meter. Push the stick fully to one side as you start boosting and the Sparrow does a quick strafing roll, even while stopped.
words.scales: More Time raises your boost speed.

notes: Phone: buttons round the right thumb; lifting a thumb fires nothing.
Only a controller has analog triggers: a key, a mouse button or a phone button is a full pull.

words.does: For 8 seconds danger prisms, blasts and overtakes cannot lower your elements; buffs still land. Missiles now reload by shooting prisms, not from crystals.

cards.name: Breakwater
cards.description: Sparrows only, against fourteen walls. Every station is a dish of plates with its throat welded shut - a triple weave of danger bars around an eye barely wider than your hull. You arrive with two rockets and one choice - blow a door, stop dead and saw one open in turret stance, or thread the eye and take nothing with you. Prisms buy rockets, so the wall you just opened pays for the next one. First team to put a pilot through the last station takes it.

cards.name: Dog Fight
cards.description: Sparrows only, in the wreck of a world that already lost. Guns score one, rockets score fifty, and the Boneyard is full of places to disappear into - hollow hulks, leaning spires, a reactor nobody should loiter near. First domain to the point target takes it.

cards.name: Salvo
cards.description: Sparrows only, and this time the Boneyard is the target. Guns chip, rockets level whole hulks, and every omni crystal you grab reloads the missile bays of your WHOLE team - so somebody fly the crystal line while somebody rains the salvos. First domain to tear down the prism target wins.

cards.name: Scurry
cards.description: Capture all crystals as fast as you can

cards.name: Wildlife Liberation
cards.description: Three cages, and wildlife everywhere - swarms, big ones and worse, scattered from the open water you spawn in all the way to the core. Shoot what swims past, break in after what does not. You never know what the next one is. First domain to the kill count takes it.

vessels.name: Scarab
vessels.description: Roll a ball you made yourself. Analog throttle and drift, a side-bump juke, and crystal-funded switch rings - the Rocket League vessel, tuned for Astro League.

Charge.description: The punch that rides the dash: push the RIGHT THUMBSTICK to the perimeter and the dash throws a swept PLATE - a broad disc lying flat across your course, starting on the hull and sweeping along the dash - shredding prisms, killing fauna and elementally debuffing any opposing pilot it engulfs. Everything it claims is thrown the way the punch travelled. Charge sets how often the plate fires: its cooldown is 2.5 s at rest down to 1.25 s at level 10 (ScarabCavitationBlast.cooldownSeconds x cooldownScale, read off the shover's replicated Charge level when the plate fires), and the debuff it bites with is the flat priced one. The dash itself is free and never paced. No input-event binding: the juke polls the right thumbstick directly (ScarabJukeController).

upgrade.label: Backdraft
upgrade.description: The shove pushes AND pulls: the plate also claims its mirror image behind the hull, doubling the swept cylinder, and everything in the back half is dragged FORWARD through the ship. At rest the shove only pushes (ScarabCavitationBlast.PlateMirrors, per-use snapshot at fire time).

words.does: Every hard dash throws a broad flat plate along your path that shreds prisms, kills creatures and debuffs any rival pilot it engulfs, flinging everything the way you dashed. It recovers in a few seconds.
words.scales: More Charge recharges the shove faster: 2.5 s at rest, 1.25 s at Charge 10.

Mass.description: Mass grows the switch's RING RADIUS - the mouth a ball has to thread (PlaceSwitchActionExecutor multiplies RingRadius by the PlaceSwitchActionSO.switchScale ElementalFloat, x1 -> x2.5 at level 10, read live at placement).

upgrade.label: Sun Cores
upgrade.description: A scored switch raises its dais WITH the super-shielded sun cores; without the upgrade the wings rise round empty crooks (ScarabSwitch.LaysDaisElement, snapshot at placement).

words.does: Place a curved ring around an elemental crystal on your path. Its panel deflects balls; any ball, friend or foe, that threads it pays you energy toward your next ball and breaks the switch into a dais of prisms.
words.scales: More Mass widens the switch's ring, an easier mouth for a ball to thread.

Space.description: While you fly, balls of your domain appear embedded in the nucleus membrane for anyone to knock loose (ScarabNucleusSeeder). Space scales the balls you seed: x1 at rest, x4 at level 10 (ScarabBallForge.SizeScaleFor, stamped once - a ball keeps the size it was born with). No input binding.

upgrade.label: Core Breaker
upgrade.description: Your balls DESTROY super-shielded prisms and fly on, where a ball is otherwise spent on one (AstroLeagueBall's replicated breaks-super-shielded stamp, read off your Space upgrade when the ball is minted, seeded or forged).

words.does: While you fly, balls of your domain appear stuck in the cell's nucleus. Anyone can knock them loose: outward they bounce harmlessly around the cell, inward they become live balls in play.
words.scales: More Space seeds bigger balls; each keeps the size it was born with.

Time.description: Time raises the top speed of the throttle ramp (authored on the transformer's ThrottleScalerMultiplier ElementalFloat, x1 -> x1.5 at level 10). The throttle is analog on the right trigger, thrust always along the nose, and releasing it is the only brake.

upgrade.label: Snap Dash
upgrade.description: Double-tap the THROTTLE (right trigger) for a hard forward burst - 500 u/s along the nose, five times the old dash - with a 5 s cooldown. Distinct from the right-stick dash, which is base kit and always available.

words.does: Thrust along your nose: the deeper you press, the harder you keep accelerating. Letting go is your only brake.
words.scales: More Time raises the throttle's top speed.

notes: Phone: buttons round the right thumb; lifting a thumb fires nothing.
A set-and-hold throttle slider.
Only a controller has analog triggers: a key, a mouse button or a phone button is a full pull.
